text: The chapter teaches how to construct 3-part chords by deriving them from 4-part 4th chord structures, a technique for streamlining and adapting voicings across different harmonic contexts. The chapter is primarily a notation/voicing-grid reference using cluster and 4th constructions with explicit no-5th and no-3rd omissions. This approach represents a practical application of chord reduction and voice-leading economy. The method demonstrates how understanding chord construction principles allows guitarists to manipulate and simplify complex harmonic shapes into more playable or musically appropriate forms.
